_about: Who school mail comes from (TDD §10 step 2.2) and which channels are broadcast-only (§11 step 3.1). 'senders' decides only whether mail counts as school mail; it never sets the audience (since 2026-10-01: a teacher's class post and her note to one family share a sender). Audience comes from ParentSquare's 'posted in <group>' line mapped through 'groups', a second household's copy (goes to Rohan), or 'channels': [{from, subject_prefix, scope, approved}], broadcast-only series Rohan approved. Never inferred from a surname. Edited only with Rohan's OK.
